items.text: A wide gathering of chemistry stands still to gather, at incoming/v392chem: its front (Natural_Chemistry_Wide_Gathering_v392chem.md) and twenty-one parts (parts/00 to 20): a corus lens; chemistry's divisions and identity, its periodic order, its rules of bonding and structure and of reactivity, thermodynamics, kinetics and series, its orders and classifications, its properties, scales and observables, its cycling, sequencing and podaling pairs and dualities, its state, flow, equilibrium and kinetics; its frontiers at nonequilibrium and flow, water and aqueous interfaces, bonding and elements, reaction dynamics and mechanism, catalysis, surfaces and electrochemistry, phases, nucleation, glass and assembly, life's origins and biochemistry, earth, atmosphere and space, and materials, nano and measurement; and a verification pass. Each observing in it is said from memory, to be checked before it enters; each part is gathered at Natural Chemistry's own motion exploring it, each observing a field's account with every number whole.
